title: Retry after a lost acknowledgement
stimulus: A job sends a notification, then crashes before recording completion. A retry sends it again. State an externally visible invariant and design a repeat-safe protocol. Explain required cooperation from the notification service.
structural_context: Duplicate external effect with a lost acknowledgement.

hints.content: Identify the precise assertion you need to justify before proposing a solution.
Look for a change in assumptions that would make your proposed reasoning fail.

validation.reason: Synthetic design fixture; requires answer-key and source review before real assessment use.
